entries.0b36c2b1d4074d6a: This field covers shield tunneling machines that dig tunnels. Japan Tunnel Systems Co., Ltd. and JIM Technology Co., Ltd. are listed as major affiliated companies. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue increased, reflecting progress on large shield-system projects, among other factors. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.1c74a48199055d06: Prime Movers (land-based prime mover plants, marine prime movers)
entries.21deda05030f4ad1: This field covers heat treatment and surface treatment (coating). IHI Hauzer Techno Coating B.V. and its four subsidiaries, Indigo TopCo Limited and its 22 subsidiaries, IHI VTN GmbH and its three subsidiaries, Jiangsu Ishikawajima Hoton Vacuum Technology Co., Ltd. and others are listed as major affiliated companies. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.2675ea7cc770ded5: This field covers rocket systems and space utilization. Manufacturing, sales and repair of space equipment and flight vehicles are handled by IHI Aerospace Co., Ltd. (Tomioka, Gunma Prefecture), in which the company holds 100.0% of the voting rights. In defense and space businesses, the company is stated to aim to create new value and improve competitiveness in response to increased defense budgets and market expansion in the space industry. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.2755d9c11d1e36db: This field covers logistics systems and industrial machinery. IHI Logistics & Industrial Systems Co., Ltd. (Koto-ku, Tokyo) provides sales, design, fabrication, procurement, construction, installation work, remodeling and repair of logistics equipment, FA equipment, industrial machinery, and sterilization and deodorization equipment, as well as maintenance services for equipment and parts. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.361ef99ab9a4148e: Japan Aircraft Engine Association (General Incorporated Foundation)
entries.398ec3d0da5c7aab: This business manufactures, sells and provides services for vehicle turbochargers, parking equipment, rotating machinery, heat and surface treatment, material handling machinery, and logistics and industrial systems, among others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥438,896 million (¥475,644 million in the previous year), the second-largest of the reportable segments. Revenue decreased, although higher unit sales and improved selling prices of vehicle turbochargers had a positive effect, due to the effects of the transfer of material handling machinery and other businesses and lower overseas demand for rotating machinery. The material handling machinery business was transferred to Tadano Ltd. on July 1, 2025.
entries.3d55c82283777028: This field covers boilers and storage facilities. IHI Plant Co., Ltd. (Koto-ku, Tokyo) designs, installs and repairs boiler equipment, nuclear equipment, environmental and storage plant equipment, industrial machinery equipment, and solar and renewable energy equipment, among others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company received orders for large projects, but there were also effects from the reversal of progress on large construction projects in the previous year. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.492aebab232f4f93: This field covers nuclear equipment. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue increased due to expansion of nuclear power. Management's analysis states that momentum for nuclear expansion, which reconciles stable supply with carbon neutrality, is strengthening. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.4b62ca8dc751f24c: This field covers turbochargers used in automobiles and other vehicles. Manufacturing of vehicle turbochargers is handled by IHI Turbo Co., Ltd., while manufacturing and sales are handled by IHI Turbo America Co., IHI TURBO (THAILAND) CO., LTD., Changchun Fuao Ishikawajima Turbocharger Co., Ltd. and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the effects of higher unit sales and improved selling prices of vehicle turbochargers were seen. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.4c70bb7fb4a67936: This field covers land-based prime mover plants and marine prime movers. IHI Power Systems Co., Ltd. (Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo) manufactures and sells internal combustion engines, gas turbine engines and marine equipment. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue increased due to higher sales of medium-sized models. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.583655c18bd59aad: This field covers parking equipment. IHI Transport Machinery Co., Ltd. (Chuo-ku, Tokyo) designs, manufactures, sells, installs, maintains and repairs parking equipment and logistics and distribution plants, and changed its trade name to IHI Parking Square Co., Ltd. effective April 1, 2026. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.5d3d61010ff49fc5: This business has manufactured, sold and provided services for bridges and sluice gates, transportation systems, shield systems and concrete building materials. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥129,642 million (¥139,736 million in the previous year). Revenue decreased, although shield-system projects with progress on large construction contributed to growth, due to the effects of the transfer of concrete building materials and transportation systems, and the reversal of progress on large bridge and sluice gate projects in the previous year. The previous year's figures are restated to reflect the change, from the fiscal year ended March 2026, of the urban development reportable segment from Social Infrastructure to Others.
entries.681517fd0e01d2cc: A heavy industry manufacturer that makes aero engines, rockets, defense equipment, prime movers for power generation, bridges, vehicle turbochargers, and more.
entries.6f3e1bbf87d407ef: This field covers defense equipment systems. Amid continued heightened geopolitical risks, and against the backdrop of policies to strengthen defense capabilities, the company continues to respond to orders for large projects. Revenue increased due to expansion of the defense business. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report, but revenue from the Ministry of Defense was ¥185,784 million (¥137,627 million in the previous year); because its monetary significance increased, it has been presented as a major customer since the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.71aabfa27b9a163a: This field covers compressors, separation equipment and marine turbochargers, among others. IHI Rotating Machinery Engineering Co., Ltd. (Koto-ku, Tokyo) designs, manufactures, sells, installs, maintains and repairs compressors, separators, marine turbochargers and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, overseas demand for rotating machinery declined. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.8672d799269349bc: In the concrete building materials business, the company transferred all shares of IHI Kenzai Kogyo Co., Ltd., a major affiliate, to Beltex Corporation on October 1, 2025. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.a3904ff21b2dc0ac: Logistics and Industrial Systems (logistics systems, industrial machinery)
entries.a8fbb0fece570eec: The material handling machinery business was transferred on July 1, 2025. Revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 reflects the effect of this transfer. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.b03bd27bc9850e91: This business manufactures, sells and provides services for aircraft engines, rocket systems and space utilization, and defense equipment systems. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥648,135 million (¥552,700 million in the previous year), the largest of the four reportable segments. Major customers are the Japan Aircraft Engine Association (General Incorporated Foundation), with revenue of ¥332,088 million, and the Ministry of Defense, with revenue of ¥185,784 million. Revenue increased due to higher sales of spare parts for commercial aircraft engines and expansion of the defense business. Space equipment and flight vehicles are manufactured, sold and repaired by IHI Aerospace Co., Ltd. In February 2026, the company transferred all shares of Meisei Electric Co., Ltd., which had handled weather, disaster prevention and space businesses in this segment.
entries.b4f15002522a4bfc: This business manufactures, sells and provides services for prime movers, carbon solutions, nuclear equipment and others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥373,475 million (¥408,301 million in the previous year), the third-largest of the reportable segments. Revenue decreased, although prime movers recorded higher revenue from nuclear expansion and higher sales of medium-sized models, due to the reversal of progress on large projects in the previous year for EPC projects at Asian bases and for carbon solutions, among other factors.
entries.b9356c79f2cac097: This field covers bridges and sluice gates. IHI Infrastructure Systems Co., Ltd. (Sakai-ku, Sakai) designs, manufactures, sells, maintains and repairs bridges, sluice gates and other products. On November 1, 2025, the company and IHI Infrastructure Construction Co., Ltd. merged. Effective April 1, 2026, the company changed its trade name to IHI Infrastructure Square Co., Ltd. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.bcdf8c82c9410c18: In the transportation systems business, on December 30, 2025, the company transferred all shares of Niigata Transys Co., Ltd., a major affiliate, to J.K.F. Co., Ltd. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.d15f8eeaba88e872: Rotating Machinery (compressors, separation equipment, marine turbochargers)
entries.d8c9ca834fb55918: This field manufactures and sells aircraft engines and also provides maintenance and other services. For commercial aircraft engines, the aftermarket business is expanding, driven by increased operating hours, among other factors. For PW1100G-JM engines already shipped, there is an additional inspection program, and the company is working with program partners to strengthen maintenance capacity. IHI Aero Engines US Co.,Ltd. invests in commercial aircraft engine programs, and GE Passport, LLC, an equity-method affiliate, provides services for the GE Passport20 engine, including manufacturing, sales, maintenance and parts supply. Revenue for this field alone is not printed in the securities report.
entries.f39850464fb462cc: It is a segment that is not included in the four reportable segments. It includes inspection and measurement businesses, the manufacture and sale of related equipment, urban development (real estate sales and leasing), and other services. Under 'Business Description,' it is described as a segment that manufactures and sells equipment and apparatus for communications, electronics, electrical measurement and information processing, provides services, and operates service businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥53,254 million (previous year: ¥50,450 million), which is smaller than that of the Social Infrastructure reportable segment. Prior-year figures are shown restated to reflect the transfer of urban development to this segment. Japan Marine United Corporation (voting rights ownership ratio 20.0%), an equity-method affiliate, is also included in this segment in the status of related companies.
